about: The design tokens of orkcraft (docs/design-system.md). Roles, never raw values, appear in a building's UI document; each face maps a role to what it can draw.

title.about: a building's name, a dialog's heading

heading.about: a pane's or a section's heading

mono.about: code, diffs, paths, terminals, the editor

status.about: the short live lines: what runs, what waits

label.about: a field's or a column's name, a key on a button

number.about: a counter, money, tokens, a percentage

gui.about: The page draws a role with orkUI's own tokens (design-system/orkui: tokens.json, tokens.css): a font role with a type style (--ork-type-<style>), a colour role with a custom property orkUI's tokens.css declares (named without its dashes). The hex values under colors are the TUI's.

about.frame: a window's or a pane's border
about.frame_focus: the border of what is selected
about.muted: what matters less: hints, timestamps, status lines
about.accent: what invites a click: the selected row, a key
about.wait: running, queued, waiting for a turn
about.fire: a question waits for the person (an ork's hut on fire)
about.harness.claude: an ork that runs on Claude Code
about.harness.agy: an ork that runs on Antigravity
about.harness.codex: an ork that runs on Codex
about.harness.hermes: an ork that runs on Hermes Agent
about.harness.pi: an ork that runs on pi
about.harness.cursor: an ork that runs on Cursor

space.about: Steps of space between and inside panes: px for a GUI, terminal cells for the TUI.
